int locate(string needle, string[] haystack)
    for: k < #haystack
        if haystack[k] == needle
            return int(k)
    return -1

string[] system_names()
    return "HEPBURN TRADITIONAL KUNREI NIHON WAPURO".split(" ")

bool contains(string alphabet, string character)
    return character != "" and alphabet.contains(character)

string lower_ascii(string value)
    source := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    target := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    result := ""
    for: k < #value
        match source.find(value[k])
            nat position
                result += target[position]
            none
                result += value[k]
    return result

string upper_ascii(string value)
    source := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    target := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    result := ""
    for: k < #value
        match source.find(value[k])
            nat position
                result += target[position]
            none
                result += value[k]
    return result

class Inventory(string[] ids, string[] rows, int[] row_ids, string[] dans, string[][] spellings, map<string, int> readings)
    const N := 108
    const Q := 109
    const L := 110

Inventory inventory()
    rows := "a ka sa ta na ha ma ya ra wa ga za da ba pa".split(" ")
    groups := "a i u e o|ka ki ku ke ko|sa si su se so|ta ti tu te to|na ni nu ne no|ha hi hu he ho|ma mi mu me mo|ya yu yo|ra ri ru re ro|wa wi we wo|ga gi gu ge go|za zi zu ze zo|da di du de do|ba bi bu be bo|pa pi pu pe po".split("|")
    string[] ids := []
    int[] row_ids := []
    string[] dans := []
    for: 0 <= r < 15
        for identifier := groups[r].split(" ")[]
            ids = ids.append(identifier)
            row_ids = row_ids.append(r)
            dans = dans.append(identifier[#identifier - 1])
    for r := [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14][]
        for suffix := ["ya", "yu", "yo"][]
            ids = ids.append(rows[r][0] + suffix)
            row_ids = row_ids.append(r)
            dans = dans.append(suffix)
    string[][] spellings := []
    systems := system_names()
    exceptions := "si ti tu hu zi di du wi we wo".split(" ")
    hepburn := "shi chi tsu fu ji ji zu i e o".split(" ")
    wapuro := "shi chi tsu fu ji di du wi we wo".split(" ")
    for system := systems[]
        hepburn_style := system == "HEPBURN" or system == "TRADITIONAL"
        string[] table := []
        for: m < #ids
            spelling := ids[m]
            exception_id := locate(spelling, exceptions)
            if hepburn_style and exception_id >= 0
                spelling = hepburn[exception_id]
            elif system == "WAPURO" and exception_id >= 0
                spelling = wapuro[exception_id]
            elif system == "KUNREI"
                if ids[m] == "di"
                    spelling = "zi"
                elif ids[m] == "du"
                    spelling = "zu"
                elif ids[m] == "wi" or ids[m] == "we" or ids[m] == "wo"
                    spelling = ids[m][1]
            if m >= 72
                prefix := ids[m][:<2]
                suffix := ids[m][2]
                if hepburn_style or system == "WAPURO"
                    if prefix == "sy"
                        spelling = "sh" + suffix
                    elif prefix == "ty"
                        spelling = "ch" + suffix
                    elif prefix == "zy" or (prefix == "dy" and hepburn_style)
                        spelling = "j" + suffix
                elif system == "KUNREI" and prefix == "dy"
                    spelling = "zy" + suffix
            table = table.append(spelling)
        spellings = spellings.append(table)
    map<string, int> readings
    for: m < #ids
        for: s < #systems
            spelling := spellings[s][m]
            if not readings.has("{systems[s]}:{spelling}")
                .readings.set("{systems[s]}:{spelling}", int(m))
            if not readings.has("NORMALIZE:{spelling}")
                .readings.set("NORMALIZE:{spelling}", int(m))
    return Inventory(ids, rows, row_ids, dans, spellings, readings)

class Reading(string problem, int[] morae, int[] columns)
class Word(string original, int start, int pattern, int[] morae, int[] columns)
class Pieces(string problem, string[] parts)
class Syllable(int mora, int width)

string at(string value, int position)
    return if 0 <= position < int(#value) then value[position] else ""

int case_pattern(string value)
    all_lower := true
    all_upper := true
    title := contains("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", value[0])
    letters := 0
    for: k < #value
        character := value[k]
        if contains("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", character)
            letters += 1
            if contains("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", character)
                all_lower = false
                if k > 0
                    title = false
            else
                all_upper = false
    if all_lower
        return 0
    if title
        return 1
    if all_upper and letters >= 2
        return 2
    return -1

Syllable syllable(const Inventory db, string system, string value, int position)
    for width := [3, 2, 1][]
        if position + width <= int(#value)
            match db.readings.get(system + ":" + value[position:<position + width])
                int mora
                    return Syllable(mora, width)
                none
                    continue
    return Syllable(-1, 0)

string column_error(int column, string message)
    return "col {column}: {message}"

Reading read_word(const Inventory db, string system, string original, int start)
    value := lower_ascii(original)
    int[] morae := []
    int[] columns := []
    p := 0
    while p < int(#value)
        c := value[p]
        c2 := at(value, p + 1)
        c3 := at(value, p + 2)
        mora := -1
        width := 1
        if c == "-"
            if #morae == 0 or morae[-1] >= db.N
                return Reading(column_error(start + p, "misplaced long mark"), [], [])
            mora = db.L
        elif c == "'"
            return Reading(column_error(start + p, "misplaced apostrophe"), [], [])
        else
            matched := syllable(db, system, value, p)
            if matched.mora >= 0
                mora = matched.mora
                width = matched.width
            elif (system == "WAPURO" or system == "NORMALIZE") and value[p:].starts_with("xtu")
                mora = db.Q
                width = 3
            elif c == "n"
                mora = db.N
                if system == "NORMALIZE"
                    if c2 == "'" or (c2 == "n" and not contains("aiueoy'", c3))
                        width = 2
                elif (system == "WAPURO" and c2 == "n") or (system != "WAPURO" and c2 == "'")
                    width = 2
            elif (system == "TRADITIONAL" or system == "NORMALIZE") and c == "m" and contains("bmp", c2)
                mora = db.N
            elif not contains("aiueon", c) and c == c2 and syllable(db, system, value, p + 1).mora >= 0
                mora = db.Q
            elif (system == "HEPBURN" or system == "TRADITIONAL" or system == "NORMALIZE") and c == "t" and c2 == "c" and c3 == "h" and syllable(db, system, value, p + 1).mora >= 0
                mora = db.Q
            else
                return Reading(column_error(start + p, "unknown syllable"), [], [])
        morae = morae.append(mora)
        columns = columns.append(start + p)
        p += width
    return Reading("", morae, columns)

int[][] long_flags(const Inventory db, int[] morae)
    pairs := array(#morae, fill = 0)
    elements := array(#morae, fill = 0)
    nat p := 0
    while p < #morae
        m := morae[p]
        if m == db.L
            elements[p] = 1
        if m < db.N and p + 1 < #morae and morae[p + 1] < 5
            vowel := db.ids[m][#db.ids[m] - 1]
            next_vowel := db.ids[morae[p + 1]]
            if vowel == next_vowel or (vowel == "o" and next_vowel == "u") or (vowel == "e" and next_vowel == "i")
                pairs[p + 1] = 1
                if vowel == "o" or (vowel == "u" and next_vowel == "u")
                    elements[p + 1] = 1
                p += 2
                continue
        p += 1
    return [pairs, elements]

Pieces write_parts(const Inventory db, string system, const Word word, string long_value)
    spellings := db.spellings[locate(system, system_names())]
    flags := long_flags(db, word.morae)
    string[] result := []
    for: k < #word.morae
        m := word.morae[k]
        next_mora := if k + 1 < #word.morae then word.morae[k + 1] else -1
        next_spelling := if 0 <= next_mora < db.N then spellings[next_mora] else ""
        first := at(next_spelling, 0)
        piece := ""
        if flags[1][k] == 1
            previous := db.ids[word.morae[k - 1]]
            vowel := previous[#previous - 1]
            if long_value == "KEEP"
                piece = if m == db.L then "-" else spellings[m]
            elif long_value == "PASSPORT"
                piece = if vowel == "o" and not contains("aiueo", first) then "h" else ""
            elif long_value == "HYPHEN"
                piece = "-"
            elif long_value == "DOUBLE"
                piece = vowel
        elif m < db.N
            piece = spellings[m]
        elif m == db.N
            if system == "WAPURO"
                piece = if next_mora == db.N or contains("aiueoyn", first) then "nn" else "n"
            elif system == "TRADITIONAL" and contains("bmp", first)
                piece = "m"
            else
                piece = if contains("aiueoy", first) then "n'" else "n"
        elif m == db.Q
            if first != "" and not contains("aiueon", first)
                piece = if (system == "HEPBURN" or system == "TRADITIONAL") and next_spelling.starts_with("ch") then "t" else first
            elif system == "WAPURO"
                piece = "xtu"
            else
                return Pieces(column_error(word.columns[k], "small tsu cannot be written"), [])
        result = result.append(piece)
    return Pieces("", result)

string apply_case(string value, int pattern, string case_value)
    actual := pattern
    if case_value == "LOWER"
        actual = 0
    elif case_value == "TITLE"
        actual = 1
    elif case_value == "UPPER"
        actual = 2
    if actual == 1
        return upper_ascii(value[0]) + value[1:]
    if actual == 2
        return upper_ascii(value)
    return value

string display_mora(const Inventory db, string system, int mora)
    if mora < db.N
        return db.spellings[locate(system, system_names())][mora]
    return ["N", "Q", "-"][mora - db.N]

int[] loose(const Inventory db, int[] morae)
    flags := long_flags(db, morae)
    return [for k := (nat(0):<#morae)[] if flags[1][k] == 0 then morae[k]]

string devoice(string identifier)
    v := locate(identifier[0], ["g", "z", "d", "b", "p"])
    return if v < 0 then identifier else ["k", "s", "t", "h", "h"][v] + identifier[1:]

int[][] key_vectors(const Inventory db, int[] morae, string order_value)
    kana_order := "a i u e o ka ki ku ke ko sa si su se so ta ti tu te to na ni nu ne no ha hi hu he ho ma mi mu me mo ya yu yo ra ri ru re ro wa wi we wo N".split(" ")
    if order_value == "IROHA"
        kana_order = "i ro ha ni ho he to ti ri nu ru wo wa ka yo ta re so tu ne na ra mu u wi no o ku ya ma ke hu ko e te a sa ki yu me mi si we hi mo se su N".split(" ")
    int[] ranks := []
    int[] voices := []
    int[] sizes := []
    int[] marks := []
    for m := morae[]
        marks = marks.append(if m == db.L then 1 else 0)
        if m == db.L
            continue
        voice := 0
        base_kana := "N"
        if m == db.Q
            base_kana = "tu"
        elif m < db.N
            base_kana = devoice(db.ids[m])
            row_id := db.row_ids[m]
            voice = if row_id == 14 then 2 elif row_id >= 10 then 1 else 0
            if m >= 72
                base_kana = base_kana[0] + "i"
        ranks = ranks.append(locate(base_kana, kana_order))
        voices = voices.append(voice)
        sizes = sizes.append(if m == db.Q then 1 else 0)
        if 72 <= m < db.N
            ranks = ranks.append(locate(db.dans[m], kana_order))
            voices = voices.append(0)
            sizes = sizes.append(1)
    return [ranks, voices, sizes, marks]

string[] base_sequence(const Inventory db, int[] morae)
    kana_order := "a i u e o ka ki ku ke ko sa si su se so ta ti tu te to na ni nu ne no ha hi hu he ho ma mi mu me mo ya yu yo ra ri ru re ro wa wi we wo N".split(" ")
    key := key_vectors(db, morae, "GOJUON")
    return kana_order[key[0]]

bool key_before(int[][] left_key, int[][] right_key)
    for: 0 <= v < 4
        count := if #left_key[v] < #right_key[v] then int(#left_key[v]) else int(#right_key[v])
        for: 0 <= k < count
            if left_key[v][k] != right_key[v][k]
                return left_key[v][k] < right_key[v][k]
        if #left_key[v] != #right_key[v]
            return #left_key[v] < #right_key[v]
    return false

bool matches_pattern(int[] pattern_ids, int[] morae)
    previous := array(#morae + 1, fill = false)
    previous[0] = true
    for token := pattern_ids[]
        current := array(#previous, fill = false)
        for: k <= #morae
            if token == -2
                current[k] = previous[k] or (k > 0 and current[k - 1])
            elif k > 0
                current[k] = previous[k - 1] and (token == -1 or token == morae[k - 1])
        previous = current
    return previous[#morae]

string execute(const Inventory db, string input_line, string[] &settings)
    fields := input_line.split(" ")
    command := fields[0]
    names := "SET TABLE CONVERT NORMALIZE REVERSE VALID DETECT DIFF SAME MORAE SYLLABLES ROW STATS SORT INDEX FIND HAIKU KAIBUN SHIRITORI".split(" ")
    if locate(command, names) < 0
        return "ERROR unknown command {command}"
    if command == "SET" or command == "TABLE"
        if #fields < 3
            return "ERROR missing argument"
        if #fields > 3
            return "ERROR too many arguments"
        if command == "SET"
            option_id := locate(fields[1], ["LONG", "CASE", "ORDER"])
            if option_id < 0
                return "ERROR unknown option {fields[1]}"
            string[][] values := [["KEEP", "DROP", "PASSPORT", "HYPHEN", "DOUBLE"], ["KEEP", "LOWER", "UPPER", "TITLE"], ["GOJUON", "IROHA"]]
            if locate(fields[2], values[option_id]) < 0
                return "ERROR unknown value {fields[2]}"
            settings[option_id] = fields[2]
            return "{fields[1]}={fields[2]}"
    argument_count := if command == "NORMALIZE" or command == "DETECT" then 0 elif command == "CONVERT" or command == "DIFF" or command == "SAME" or command == "FIND" then 2 else 1
    if command != "TABLE" and int(#fields) < argument_count + 2
        return "ERROR missing argument"
    systems := system_names()
    source := "NORMALIZE"
    target := "NORMALIZE"
    if argument_count > 0
        source = fields[1]
        if locate(source, systems) < 0
            return "ERROR unknown system {source}"
        target = source
    if command == "CONVERT" or command == "DIFF" or command == "SAME"
        target = fields[2]
        if locate(target, systems) < 0
            return "ERROR unknown system {target}"
    if command == "TABLE"
        row_id := locate(fields[2], db.rows)
        if row_id < 0
            return "ERROR unknown row {fields[2]}"
        spellings := db.spellings[locate(source, systems)]
        result := [for m := (nat(0):<#db.ids)[] if db.row_ids[m] == row_id then spellings[m]]
        return result.join(" ")
    text_start := int(#command) + 1
    for: 1 <= k <= argument_count
        text_start += int(#fields[k]) + 1
    text := input_line[text_start:]
    int[] pattern_ids := []
    if command == "FIND"
        segment := ""
        for: 0 <= p <= int(#fields[2])
            c := at(fields[2], p)
            if c == "" or c == "?" or c == "*"
                parsed_segment := read_word(db, source, segment, 1)
                if parsed_segment.problem != ""
                    return "ERROR invalid pattern"
                pattern_ids = pattern_ids.concat(parsed_segment.morae)
                if c != ""
                    pattern_ids = pattern_ids.append(if c == "?" then -1 else -2)
                segment = ""
            elif contains("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'-", c)
                segment += c
            else
                return "ERROR invalid pattern"
    allow_slash := command == "SAME" or command == "HAIKU"
    string separators := " 0123456789.,!?;:()" + DQ + (if allow_slash then "/" else "")
    letters := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'-"
    for: 0 <= p < int(#text)
        if not contains(separators + letters, text[p])
            return "ERROR " + column_error(p + 1, "invalid character")
    Word[] words := []
    int[] word_lines := []
    poem_line := 0
    p := 0
    while p < int(#text)
        if contains(letters, text[p])
            start := p
            while p < int(#text) and contains(letters, text[p])
                p += 1
            original := text[start:<p]
            words = words.append(Word(original, start + 1, case_pattern(original), [], []))
            word_lines = word_lines.append(poem_line)
        else
            if text[p] == "/"
                poem_line += 1
            p += 1
    line_words := array(nat(poem_line + 1), fill = 0)
    for line_id := word_lines[]
        line_words[line_id] += 1
    if command == "SAME" and (poem_line != 1 or line_words[0] == 0 or line_words[1] == 0)
        return "ERROR expected two texts"
    if command == "HAIKU"
        if poem_line != 2 and poem_line != 4
            return "ERROR expected 3 or 5 lines"
        for count := line_words[]
            if count == 0
                return "ERROR expected 3 or 5 lines"
    if #words == 0
        return "ERROR no words"
    for word := words[]
        if word.pattern < 0
            return "ERROR " + column_error(word.start, "mixed case")
    if command == "DETECT"
        string[] results := []
        for system := systems[]
            verdict := "canonical"
            for word := words[]
                reading := read_word(db, system, word.original, word.start)
                if reading.problem != ""
                    verdict = "error"
                    break
                parsed := Word(word.original, word.start, word.pattern, reading.morae, reading.columns)
                written := write_parts(db, system, parsed, "KEEP")
                if written.problem != ""
                    verdict = "error"
                    break
                if apply_case(written.parts.join(""), word.pattern, "KEEP") != word.original
                    verdict = "readable"
            results = results.append("{system}={verdict}")
        return results.join(" ")
    for: k < #words
        system := if command == "SAME" and word_lines[k] == 1 then target else source
        reading := read_word(db, system, words[k].original, words[k].start)
        if reading.problem != ""
            return "ERROR " + reading.problem
        words[k].morae = reading.morae
        words[k].columns = reading.columns
    if command == "NORMALIZE"
        target = "HEPBURN"
    if command == "CONVERT" or command == "NORMALIZE" or command == "REVERSE"
        result := ""
        cursor := 0
        for word := words[]
            result += text[cursor:<word.start - 1]
            writable := word
            if command == "REVERSE"
                for: k < #writable.morae
                    if writable.morae[k] == db.L
                        previous := db.ids[writable.morae[k - 1]]
                        writable.morae[k] = locate(previous[#previous - 1], db.ids)
                writable.morae = writable.morae[::-1]
                writable.columns = writable.columns[::-1]
            written := write_parts(db, target, writable, settings[0])
            if written.problem != ""
                return "ERROR " + written.problem
            result += apply_case(written.parts.join(""), word.pattern, settings[1])
            cursor = word.start - 1 + int(#word.original)
        return result + text[cursor:]
    if command == "VALID"
        for word := words[]
            written := write_parts(db, source, word, "KEEP")
            if written.problem != ""
                return "ERROR " + written.problem
            canonical := apply_case(written.parts.join(""), word.pattern, "KEEP")
            if canonical != word.original
                k := 0
                while k < int(#canonical) and k < int(#word.original) and canonical[k] == word.original[k]
                    k += 1
                return "INVALID col {word.start + k}: expected {canonical}"
        return "VALID"
    if command == "DIFF" or command == "FIND"
        string[] selected := []
        for word := words[]
            if command == "FIND"
                if matches_pattern(pattern_ids, word.morae)
                    selected = selected.append(word.original)
            else
                left := write_parts(db, source, word, settings[0])
                if left.problem != ""
                    return "ERROR " + left.problem
                right := write_parts(db, target, word, settings[0])
                if right.problem != ""
                    return "ERROR " + right.problem
                a := apply_case(left.parts.join(""), word.pattern, settings[1])
                b := apply_case(right.parts.join(""), word.pattern, settings[1])
                if a != b
                    selected = selected.append("{a}>{b}")
        result := "{#selected} of {#words}"
        return result + (if #selected == 0 then "" else ": " + selected.join(" "))
    if command == "SAME"
        n_left := line_words[0]
        n_right := line_words[1]
        exact := true
        count := if n_left < n_right then n_left else n_right
        for: 0 <= k < count
            if loose(db, words[k].morae) != loose(db, words[n_left + k].morae)
                return "DIFFERENT at word {k + 1}"
            if words[k].morae != words[n_left + k].morae
                exact = false
        if n_left != n_right
            return "DIFFERENT at word {count + 1}"
        return if exact then "EXACT" else "LOOSE"
    if command == "HAIKU"
        counts := array(nat(poem_line + 1), fill = 0)
        for: k < #words
            counts[word_lines[k]] += int(#words[k].morae)
        int[] expected := if poem_line == 2 then [5, 7, 5] else [5, 7, 5, 7, 7]
        count_text := [for count := counts[] then string(count)]
        return (if counts == expected then "OK " else "NG ") + (if poem_line == 2 then "haiku " else "tanka ") + count_text.join("-")
    if command == "MORAE" or command == "SYLLABLES" or command == "ROW" or command == "STATS"
        string[] groups := []
        total := 0
        row_counts := array(10, fill = 0)
        other_counts := array(6, fill = 0)
        for word := words[]
            string[] pieces := []
            if command == "SYLLABLES"
                written := write_parts(db, source, word, "KEEP")
                if written.problem != ""
                    return "ERROR " + written.problem
                pieces = written.parts
            flags := long_flags(db, word.morae)
            string[] parts := []
            for: k < #word.morae
                m := word.morae[k]
                display := display_mora(db, source, m)
                if command == "SYLLABLES"
                    if k > 0 and (m >= db.N or flags[0][k] == 1)
                        parts[-1] += pieces[k]
                    else
                        parts = parts.append(pieces[k])
                        total += 1
                elif command == "MORAE"
                    parts = parts.append(display)
                    total += 1
                elif command == "ROW"
                    groups = groups.append(display + ": " + (if m >= db.N then "special" else db.rows[db.row_ids[m]] + " " + db.dans[m]))
                else
                    total += 1
                    if m >= db.N
                        other_counts[m - db.N + 3] += 1
                    else
                        r := db.row_ids[m]
                        base_row := if r < 10 then r else [1, 2, 3, 5, 5][r - 10]
                        row_counts[base_row] += 1
                        if r == 14
                            other_counts[1] += 1
                        elif r >= 10
                            other_counts[0] += 1
                        if m >= 72
                            other_counts[2] += 1
            if command == "MORAE" or command == "SYLLABLES"
                groups = groups.append(parts.join("."))
        if command == "ROW"
            return groups.join(", ")
        if command == "MORAE" or command == "SYLLABLES"
            return "{total}: " + groups.join(" ")
        result := "morae={total}"
        for: 0 <= r < 10
            if row_counts[r] > 0
                result += " {db.rows[r]}={row_counts[r]}"
        labels := ["voiced", "semivoiced", "contracted", "N", "Q", "L"]
        for: 0 <= k < 6
            result += " {labels[k]}={other_counts[k]}"
        return result
    if command == "SORT" or command == "INDEX"
        int[] order_ids := []
        int[][][] keys := []
        for: 0 <= k < int(#words)
            keys = keys.append(key_vectors(db, words[k].morae, settings[2]))
            order_ids = order_ids.append(k)
            p_insert := k
            while p_insert > 0 and key_before(keys[k], keys[order_ids[p_insert - 1]])
                order_ids[p_insert] = order_ids[p_insert - 1]
                p_insert -= 1
            order_ids[p_insert] = k
        string[] groups := []
        last_heading := ""
        for word_id := order_ids[]
            if command == "SORT"
                groups = groups.append(words[word_id].original)
                continue
            first_kana := base_sequence(db, words[word_id].morae)[0]
            heading := first_kana
            if settings[2] == "GOJUON" and first_kana != "N"
                heading = db.rows[db.row_ids[locate(first_kana, db.ids)]]
            if heading == last_heading
                groups[-1] += " " + words[word_id].original
            else
                groups = groups.append("{heading}: {words[word_id].original}")
                last_heading = heading
        return groups.join(if command == "SORT" then " " else "; ")
    if command == "KAIBUN"
        string[] sequence := []
        for word := words[]
            sequence = sequence.concat(base_sequence(db, word.morae))
        return (if sequence == sequence[::-1] then "YES " else "NO ") + sequence.join(".")
    previous_tail := ""
    for: 0 <= k < int(#words)
        sequence := base_sequence(db, words[k].morae)
        prefix := "NG {k + 1}: {words[k].original}"
        if k > 0 and sequence[0] != previous_tail
            return prefix + " must start with " + display_mora(db, source, locate(previous_tail, db.ids))
        for: 0 <= earlier < k
            if words[earlier].morae == words[k].morae
                return prefix + " is repeated"
        previous_tail = sequence[-1]
        if previous_tail == "N"
            return prefix + " ends with N"
    return "OK {#words}"

    string command_line

    println(execute(database, command_line, &current_settings))
